Name: Void Coffee
Author: basemwnt
Description:
[center][i][b]"Void Coffee, a strong and bitter aroma with an even stronger kick! So strong in fact, there is a small consequence to consuming this devilish beverage.."

[/b][/i][/center]Void Coffee is loosely based off of Black Rifle Coffee, a coffee brand made by veterans. Which is why Kent loves it so much!

To make Void Coffee, you will need:
- 99x Void Essence
- 1x Triple Shot Espresso

This coffee blend is twice as fast and lasts twice as long compared to Triple Shot Espresso! ( +2 speed, ~8mins )
However, its *so* strong that you end up losing a little bit of energy in the process ( so far just 12 energy! )
